You can’t go to space;) Show less Read more Like Dislike Reply @LadieKadie 2 weeks ago No one cares Show less Read more Like 1 Dislike Reply 4 replies Hide replies 4 replies Top is selected, so you'll see featured comments Comments 20 Top Show featured comments Newest Show recent comments, including potential spam In this video Transcript Description COUNTDOWN TO LIFTOFF: ARTEMIS II LAUNCH LIVE COVERAGE #HeyJB WFLA's Stream Center team is providing coverage leading to, during, and after the Artemis II launch via uninterrupted livestream. NASA is launching four astronauts aboard the Space Launch System (SLS) from Kennedy Space Center. This marks the beginning of the first human deep-space mission since 1972, as the crew is scheduled for a roughly 10 day flyby of the moon. Over the course of the stream, WFLA’s JB Biunno and Josh Scott will interview experts, react to the launch, and engage with audience members. Additionally, WFLA and Nexstar’s NASA correspondent Meteorologist Amanda Holly will provide multiple hits from the Kennedy Space Center leading up to the mission’s launch. Expert live guests expected: Dr. Jessica Libby-Roberts, University of Tampa Professor of Physics and Astronomy Dr. James Head III, Brown University Professor & Apollo Mission Geology Advisor Pre-recorded live guest spots: Dr. Clive Neal, Notre Dame Professor of Environmental Engineering & Earth Sciences, Lunar Expert Brian Matisak, NASA Space Launch System, Systems Engineering and Integration Lead …...more ...more Show less Transcript Follow along using the transcript.
